games.title: Minecraft Java
games.description: Fabric performance mods, shaders and shared APIs, pinned to Minecraft Java 1.21.1.
games.requirements: These files target Minecraft Java 1.21.1 with Java 21 and Fabric Loader 0.16.0 or later, not Bedrock. Include Fabric API for Sodium’s required API modules. Iris below requires the exact Sodium build listed alongside it; its upstream filename is labelled beta.1.
games.setup: Install Fabric for Minecraft Java 1.21.1, then place the chosen JARs in that profile’s mods folder. Iris needs Sodium; shader packs are separate downloads.

games.title: Stardew Valley
games.description: SMAPI, automation, shared storage and content-pack tools for your farm.
games.requirements: SMAPI 4.5.2 requires Stardew Valley 1.6.14 or later on Windows, Linux, macOS or Steam Deck. This desktop installer is not an Android SMAPI build. Author pages below have their own version and dependency requirements.
games.setup: Install the matching SMAPI build using its included instructions. Open each author page and choose a mod file matching your game and SMAPI version; extract its mod folder into Mods.

games.title: Terraria
games.description: tModLoader and author resources for crafting searches and boss progression.
games.requirements: Use mods built for your tModLoader branch. The old Recipe Browser and Boss Checklist GitHub binaries target tModLoader 0.11.8.3, so they are not presented as current downloads here.
games.setup: Install the pinned tModLoader build using its release instructions or use the supported Steam installation. Find compatible Recipe Browser and Boss Checklist versions through its Mod Browser or the author pages.

games.title: Hollow Knight
games.description: Randomizer 4, the Modding API and Lumafly for managing your mod setup.
games.requirements: Modding API v77 targets Hollow Knight 1.5.78.11833 on Windows. Randomizer 4 requires Hollow Knight 1.5+, MenuChanger, ItemChanger, RandomizerCore and RandomizerCore.Json; it does not support game 1.4.3.2 or earlier.
games.setup: Lumafly can manage compatible mods and dependencies. For manual installation, follow the API and Randomizer documentation and install every required dependency before enabling Randomizer.

games.title: Celeste
games.description: Everest and community map resources for new climbs and campaigns.
games.requirements: Everest supports desktop Steam, itch.io and Epic versions of Celeste on Windows, Linux and macOS. The Windows Store edition is not supported. Map packs can require additional helper mods and minimum Everest builds.
games.setup: For manual setup, copy the contents of main.zip’s main folder beside Celeste.exe and follow the official MiniInstaller instructions for your OS. Map ZIPs go in Mods without extracting them; install their dependencies too.

games.title: Elden Ring
games.description: Seamless Co-op with an explicit game-version pin and author setup notes.
games.requirements: Seamless Co-op v2.0.1 is the author’s update for Elden Ring game version 1.17. Match this pinned build to that game version; do not substitute a newer game update without checking the author’s release notes.
games.setup: Read the setup instructions included in the release and the author’s documentation. All players need a compatible mod and game version; configure and launch the mod as the author describes.
